description: The bar chart compares the performance of three language models—SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN—across several evaluation metrics: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and an average (AVG). The vertical axis represents the performance score, with values ranging from approximately 0.4 to 1.0. For each metric, three bars are displayed: a dark blue bar for the base model (SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0), a light blue bar for Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and a light gray bar for the KoBEST variants. The base model consistently achieves a score of 1.00 across all metrics, serving as the reference point. The Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 model shows varying performance, with scores ranging from 0.46 (PT-EVAL) to 0.74 (KoBEST-CP). The KoBEST models demonstrate higher performance than Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 in most cases, with scores ranging from 0.50 (KoBEST-HS) to 0.74 (KoBEST-CP). Notably, the KoBEST-CP model achieves the highest score among all models for the KoBEST-CP metric, while the Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 model performs best on the PT-EVAL metric. The average scores for the three models are 0.57 for Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, 0.61 for KoBEST-CP, and 1.00 for the base model.
